description: This file defines a SessionRepository class that manages in-memory authentication session states using Kotlin's Flow for observability. It provides methods to set and get the current authentication state, manage login/logout, and handle session locking.

classes.name: SessionRepository
classes.description: Manages in-memory authentication session states, providing observable state updates and methods to transition between logged out, locked, and unlocked states.

methods.name: stateFlow
methods.description: Provides an observable flow of the current authentication state for UI or ViewModel consumers.

methods.name: setLoggedOut
methods.description: Sets the current session state to LoggedOut.

methods.name: setLocked
methods.description: Sets the session state to Locked with a given session token and lock reason.

methods.name: setUnlocked
methods.description: Sets the session state to Unlocked with provided session tokens.

methods.name: currentTokensOrNull
methods.description: Returns current session tokens if the user is logged in or null if logged out.
